name: adversarial-peers
description: Peer-agent skills for Codex, Claude Code, and Antigravity (agy). Invoke only when the user selects the peer.

plugins.name: codex-peer
plugins.description: Call Codex when explicitly requested, or resume an existing Codex call.

plugins.name: cc-peer
plugins.description: Call Claude Code when explicitly requested, or resume an existing Claude call.

plugins.name: agy-peer
plugins.description: Call Antigravity (agy / Gemini) when explicitly requested, or resume an existing agy call.
